title: Find out why a Vercel deploy failed
goal: Open the build log of a failed deploy and find the line that says what went wrong

steps.say: Open your project in the Vercel dashboard.
steps.find: your project's name in the list of projects

steps.say: Click the deployment marked Error (the red one).
steps.find: the deployment with the Error status

steps.say: On that page, find Deployment Details and open the Building section to show the build logs.
steps.find: Building in the Deployment Details section

instead.say: If there is no Building section, the error is shown on the page itself. Read it there.
instead.find: the error message shown over the deployment page

steps.say: Scroll to the red words that say Error. The last one often only says the build exited; the real cause is a few lines above it.
steps.find: the red Error lines in the build log

steps.say: Press Control, Option, Command and F in Companion to find the same place in your project. If Provisioning Integrations failed, do not press Skip.
steps.find: Companion's character on the edge of the screen
